
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zxlh1529/p/19337695" title="发布于 2025-12-11 17:58">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">2025 CSS 样式简单总结</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>简单说下 2025 CSS 的部分更新以及新增吧，这里就不详细给示例了，有需要自行 AI 生成或者看下最后文章介绍，可能他们的更详细点，当然先看完 bro 别给拉到最后直接看别人的！！！</p>
<h2 id="1-布局与响应式设计增强">1. 布局与响应式设计增强</h2>
<h3 id="容器查询container-queries">容器查询（Container Queries）</h3>
<p>允许根据元素自身 <em>容器尺寸</em> 而不是视口调整样式，更适合组件化设计，比传统媒体查询更灵活。(<a href="https://codevisionz.com/css-trends-in-2025-whats-new-and-whats-dead/?utm_source=cnblogs.com" title="CSS Trends in 2025: What’s New and What’s Dead?" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Codevisionz</a>)</p>
<pre><code class="language-css">.container {
  container-type: inline-size;
}
@container (min-width: 500px) {
  .card { font-size: 1.2rem; }
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 id="子网格subgrid">子网格（Subgrid）</h3>
<p>子网格让内部网格继承父网格轨道，不用重复定义 grid 结构，特别适合复杂布局。(<a href="https://blog.riadkilani.com/2025/08/06/exploring-new-features-in-css-what-you-need-to-know-in-2025/?utm_source=cnblogs.com" title="Exploring New Features in CSS: What You Need to Know in 2025 |" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">blog.riadkilani.com</a>)</p>
<pre><code class="language-css">.parent { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr; }
.child { display: grid; grid-template-columns: subgrid; }
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 id="原生-masonry-布局提案实验">原生 Masonry 布局（提案／实验）</h3>
<p>Pinterest 风格的级联布局已经在一些浏览器的试验版本中支持，可减少对 JavaScript 的依赖。(<a href="https://webtech.tools/new-css-features-in-2025/?utm_source=cnblogs.com" title="New CSS Features in 2025: The Latest Game-Changing Updates for Developers | WebTech Tools" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">webtech.tools</a>)</p>
<pre><code class="language-css">.grid { display: masonry; gap:1rem; }
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="2-更强的选择器与逻辑控制">2. 更强的选择器与逻辑控制</h2>
<h3 id="父级选择器-has">父级选择器 <code>:has()</code></h3>
<p>真正实现基于子元素条件的父级样式定义，是一个非常重要的动态样式工具。(<a href="https://blog.riadkilani.com/2025/08/06/exploring-new-features-in-css-what-you-need-to-know-in-2025/?utm_source=cnblogs.com" title="Exploring New Features in CSS: What You Need to Know in 2025 |" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">blog.riadkilani.com</a>)</p>
<pre><code class="language-css">form:has(input:invalid) { border-color: red; }
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 id="if-函数实验"><code>if()</code> 函数（实验）</h3>
<p>浏览器（如最新 Chrome）已支持部分逻辑判断表达式，用于根据条件切换样式值（目前仍在推进中）。(<a href="https://www.reddit.com/r/css/comments/1l2ru5b?utm_source=cnblogs.com" title="I used the new feature in chrome and edge." target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Reddit</a>)</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="3-结构书写与可维护性改善">3. 结构书写与可维护性改善</h2>
<h3 id="css-嵌套nesting">CSS 嵌套（Nesting）</h3>
<p>CSS 原生支持嵌套选择器，无需 SCSS 等预处理器。(<a href="https://medium.com/%40shashirupapara/whats-new-in-css-2025-a-developer-s-guide-to-the-future-of-styling-d34e96a2f6d4?utm_source=cnblogs.com" title="What’s New in CSS 2025? A Developer’s Guide to the Future of Styling | by shashi rupapara | Medium" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Medium</a>)</p>
<pre><code class="language-css">.card {
  color: #000;
  &amp; h2 { font-size: 1.5rem; }
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 id="局部样式作用域-scope">局部样式作用域 <code>@scope</code></h3>
<p>让选择器作用局限于特定 DOM 范围，降低样式冲突风险。(<a href="https://medium.com/%40developer.minhaj/all-new-css-features-in-2025-the-future-is-now-69bfbe80c9f1?utm_source=cnblogs.com" title="All New CSS Features in 2025: The Future Is Now | by Md Minahjul Islam | Medium" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Medium</a>)</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="4-自定义属性更智能">4. 自定义属性更智能</h2>
<h3 id="property"><code>@property</code></h3>
<p>定义 CSS 变量时增加 <em>类型检查</em>、<em>初始值</em> 和 <em>继承选项</em> 支持，有助于更严谨的设计系统和动画控制。(<a href="https://medium.com/%40developer.minhaj/all-new-css-features-in-2025-the-future-is-now-69bfbe80c9f1?utm_source=cnblogs.com" title="All New CSS Features in 2025: The Future Is Now | by Md Minahjul Islam | Medium" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Medium</a>)</p>
<pre><code class="language-css">@property --main-color {
  syntax: '&lt;color&gt;';
  inherits: false;
  initial-value: blue;
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="5-新-ui互动功能">5. 新 UI/互动功能</h2>
<h3 id="原生-carouselpopovers-与-interest-invoker">原生 Carousel、Popovers 与 Interest Invoker</h3>
<p>Chrome 135 引入了无需 JS 的轮播、可声明弹出组件和兴趣触发 API，简化 UI 构建。(<a href="https://developer.chrome.com/blog/web-at-io25?utm_source=cnblogs.com" title="10 updates from Google I/O 2025: CSS carousels, AI-powered DevTools, Prompt API with multimodal capabilities, and more &nbsp;|&nbsp; Blog &nbsp;|&nbsp; Chrome for Developers" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Chrome for Developers</a>)</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="scroll-linked-动画">Scroll-Linked 动画</h3>
<p>滚动进度驱动动画，使视觉效果与滚动位置自然联动，性能优于 JS。(<a href="https://webtech.tools/new-css-features-in-2025/?utm_source=cnblogs.com" title="New CSS Features in 2025: The Latest Game-Changing Updates for Developers | WebTech Tools" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">webtech.tools</a>)</p>
<pre><code class="language-css">.element {
  animation: fade 1s linear;
  animation-timeline: scroll();
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="6-其他实用增强">6. 其他实用增强</h2>
<h3 id="typography--精确布局">Typography &amp; 精确布局</h3>
<ul>
<li><code>text-box-trim</code> / <code>text-box-align</code> 提高文字框微调能力。(<a href="https://webtech.tools/new-css-features-in-2025/?utm_source=cnblogs.com" title="New CSS Features in 2025: The Latest Game-Changing Updates for Developers | WebTech Tools" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">webtech.tools</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="-颜色处理">🖌 颜色处理</h3>
<ul>
<li>相对颜色语法（如 <code>color-mix()</code> 或 Lab/LCH 色彩空间）让主题色调更灵活先进。(<a href="https://medium.com/%40sankarums/11-new-css-features-you-can-actually-use-in-2025-399274cd792a?utm_source=cnblogs.com" title="11 New CSS Features You Can Actually Use in 2025 | by sankar marimuthu | Medium" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Medium</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="其他细节增强部分已普及">其他细节增强（部分已普及）</h3>
<ul>
<li><code>content-visibility: auto</code> 优化渲染性能。(<a href="https://medium.com/%40sankarums/11-new-css-features-you-can-actually-use-in-2025-399274cd792a?utm_source=cnblogs.com" title="11 New CSS Features You Can Actually Use in 2025 | by sankar marimuthu | Medium" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Medium</a>)</li>
<li><code>scrollbar-gutter</code> 控制滚动条布局稳定性。(<a href="https://medium.com/%40sankarums/11-new-css-features-you-can-actually-use-in-2025-399274cd792a?utm_source=cnblogs.com" title="11 New CSS Features You Can Actually Use in 2025 | by sankar marimuthu | Medium" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Medium</a>)</li>
<li>更多原生表单相关属性如自动调整输入大小等新提案。(<a href="https://skynix.co/resources/whats-new-in-css-for-2025?utm_source=cnblogs.com" title="What’s New in CSS for 2025" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Skynix LLC</a>)</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="so-2025-css-progress">SO 2025 CSS PROGRESS</h2>
<ul>
<li>布局能力更强（容器查询、子网格、masonry）</li>
<li>逻辑更丰富（<code>:has()</code>、<code>if()</code> 等）</li>
<li>安全可维护性提升（<code>@property</code>、<code>@scope</code>）</li>
<li>动画与 UI 组件更容易实现（本地 carousel、scroll 动画）</li>
<li>减少对 JavaScript 的依赖成为重要方向</li>
</ul>
<p>这些进展让 CSS 不再只是样式语言，而更像是 <em>响应式、模块化、动态 UI 构建的声明式语言</em>。(<a href="https://developer.chrome.com/blog/web-at-io25?utm_source=cnblogs.com" title="10 updates from Google I/O 2025: CSS carousels, AI-powered DevTools, Prompt API with multimodal capabilities, and more &nbsp;|&nbsp; Blog &nbsp;|&nbsp; Chrome for Developers" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Chrome for Developers</a>)</p>
<hr>

</div>
